sentence: This project uses health data from veterans to find genes linked to carotid stenosis and measure how risk factors affect it.
This project builds a clinical decision support tool that helps dentists screen for and diagnose intimate partner violence.
This project studies how cellular antiviral responses affect tumor-related processes during infection with a herpesvirus that causes Kaposi's sarcoma.
This project builds a targeted delivery system for immunoregulatory molecules used in transplantation to make them work better and be less toxic.
This project builds a set of reagents to check Drosophila models of human mitochondrial diseases.
This project studies what lets invasive fungal infection take hold in vulnerable patients, looking at systemic immunity and changes in sinonasal tissue.
This project studies how mutations in one gene affect tumor progression and peritoneal metastasis in gastrointestinal cancers.
This project builds an RNA-based medicine that reprograms reactive astrocytes for therapeutic benefit.
This project studies how nuclear speckles control gene regulation.
This project uses Artificial Intelligence to analyze data from genomic assays to find biomarkers of aging.
This project uses genetic screens to map how genes interact in tumors, so therapies can be tailored to a patient's tumor.
This project studies how family, childcare, and neighborhood factors relate to sleep problems and development in Black and White preschoolers.
This project tries to find out why fractures do not heal well when breast cancer cells are present.
This project tries to find out which mechanisms drive growth of an aggressive cancer, midline carcinoma, while blocking differentiation.
This project studies how trophoblast stem cells develop into invasive cells that invade the uterus.
This project studies which proteins interact with a fusion oncoprotein in pediatric acute myeloid leukemia and whether disrupting puncta matters for therapy.
This project studies why inborn errors of immunity share symptoms and why patients with identical variants have different clinical courses.
This project builds folding tags that make cytokines, needed for cell culture, easier to purify.
This project studies cannabis use and its links to falls, fractures, and dementia in aging people with HIV, and builds a tool.
This project studies mild brain injury in children, using imaging and blood-based biomarkers to follow recovery over months.
